## Proposed Topic

What topic would you like to see added to the study guide?

## Module / Phase

Which module or phase should this topic belong to? If you are unsure, describe
where you think it fits in the learning progression.

## Why It Should Be Included

Explain why this topic is important for AI engineers and how it fits into the
existing syllabus.

## Resources / References

List any relevant resources such as papers, blog posts, documentation, courses,
or tools that could serve as source material.
